library_convention.world_to_camera: x = d·right, y = d·upv, z = d·fwd（z 向前为正）；px = W/2 + (x/z)·f_px，py = H/2 - (y/z)·f_px
library_convention.f_px: f_px = H / (2·tan(fov_y/2))，fov_y = 2·atan(sensor_mm/2 / focal_mm)；f_px 是权威内参
library_convention.usd_aperture: horizontalAperture = sensor_mm·W/H，verticalAperture = sensor_mm （方形像素，两轴 f_px 一致）
library_convention.gltf_camera: Y-up 世界系（p_yup = (x, z, −y)，契约里唯一那一处换算）；局部 +X 右 / +Y 上 / −Z 前
library_convention.authority: assets/validation/camera_intrinsics.json 是逐帧内外参唯一权威源

scene.source_convention: objects[].source 是 assets/manifest.json 里的 asset_id 引用（v2 起不再是文件路径）；文件路径见 assets[].path
